findings.title: PR description links to issues that don't exist in this repo
findings.claim: Issues #1085, #1086, #1091, #1093, #1106 linked in the PR description all return 'Could not resolve' in dkropachev/tidepool, and the Refs: URL for issue 1091 points to that missing issue; as a result the claimed prerequisite '#1093, which rejects dim < 1' isn't present, and the three 'Out' items (nested vector decoding into interface{}, trailing bytes, negative vint length) aren't tracked anywhere.

findings.title: Stale comment claims empty non-nil payloads with Dimensions>0 still fall through to…
findings.claim: The comment says 'nil/empty and dim=0 fall through to the generic path,' but the new bound at marshal.go:998-1002 now rejects an empty non-nil payload with Dimensions > 0 before that point; only nil and dim=0 still fall through.

findings.title: Test comment claims 32-bit coverage that can't currently be exercised
findings.claim: The comment says the word-size-based cases make 'the wrap land on a 32-bit target too,' but the package can't currently be built for 32-bit (GOARCH=386 go vet fails in serialization/varint/marshal_ints.go:126 due to int56 constants overflowing int); the comment claims coverage nobody can run.

findings.title: PR body includes forbidden Claude Code attribution line
findings.claim: The PR body ends with '🤖 Generated with Claude Code,' which the user's global instructions forbid from appearing in PR descriptions.
